8. Match the parts of sentences from Columns A and B to make five complete sentences. One option in Column B is extra.

Topic: School library

Column A
(a) A librarian
(b) A borrower
(c) A dictionary
(d) A reading room
(e) A library card

Column B
(1) arranges books on shelves
(2) identifies a registered borrower
(3) provides a quiet place to read
(4) cannot replace a lost bus ticket
(5) explains the meanings of words
(6) returns a book on its due date
items.explanation:
(a) → (1): A librarian arranges books on shelves.
(b) → (6): A borrower returns a book on its due date.
(c) → (5): A dictionary explains the meanings of words.
(d) → (3): A reading room provides a quiet place to read.
(e) → (2): A library card identifies a registered borrower.

Column A

(b) It keeps one fit and
(c) By observing certain rules, one
(d) One is to take
(e) He is to observe

Column B
(1) can keep good health
(2) balanced diet, take regular exercise and rest, etc.
(3) free from diseases
(4) the rules of cleanliness
(5) soundness of body and mind
(6) follow the rules of health
items.explanation:
(a) → (5): Good health means soundness of body and mind.
(b) → (3): It keeps one fit and free from diseases.
(c) → (1): By observing certain rules, one can keep good health.
(d) → (2): One is to take balanced diet, take regular exercise and rest, etc..
(e) → (4): He is to observe the rules of cleanliness.

8. Match the parts of sentences from Columns A and B to make five complete sentences.

Column A
(a) UNICEF originally stood for the
(b) It gives long-term help
(c) The main objective of UNICEF is
(d) It also undertakes
(e) Bangladesh is a

Column B
(1) to decrease neonatal death
(2) humanitarian work to help the affected people
(3) member of UNICEF
(4) to the children of developing nations
(5) United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund
items.explanation:
(a) → (5): UNICEF originally stood for the United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund.
(b) → (4): It gives long-term help to the children of developing nations.
(c) → (1): The main objective of UNICEF is to decrease neonatal death.
(d) → (2): It also undertakes humanitarian work to help the affected people.
(e) → (3): Bangladesh is a member of UNICEF.
